textContent:
1. The first timeline will be shown.... i.e. A attends the LIT clg and his dad dies and he follows V and finally becomes V himself but then B and F also ends up dieing (previously he was writing the ending of his own story of AC) finally he sees his reality as a story that someone else is writing and also realises that this suffering is not new he has suffered it again and again in a countless loop. And he blames his writer/creator for always ending up with the same sufferable ending for him in each universe. <<<<< This story will later on turns out to be the turning point where A opens up the gate or creates a bridge between different universes >>>>>.
2. He cries his throut out and suddenly he wakes up in the class where H was teaching!!! H tells him to see him after the classes. 
3. H and the others were already aware of the powers, expereinces and memories from the other lifes of each character. They teaches A to understand this power where A excels with a margin after each stage. 
4. Each character will go through the memories from their different lifes and takes control over them.
5. These memories form different universes will have separate chapters. 
6. But it turns out that some of the characters from these other universes are too powerful and they takes control of their body in this universe and all the other universe who were able to open the bridge to a certain level! Let's call them the ultimate chars.
7. In the end each of these ultimate chars from each universe will take over all the worlds and have a final battle at the same/ similar places in each of the universes with different animations in each universe!
8. In the end A remembers everything and puts down all the ultimate chars. 
9. But then everything crashes as soon as he kills everyone in every universe!
10. Again the story revinds to the first world where he was going to kill B and F. As he as the actuall murderer all alone but he stops and understands that this is a test. 
11. The ultimate test that the creator has created and simulated an endless cycle until A passes the test.
12. The key was to forgive each characters despite their mistakes and cruelty that they did. Each chars had their own reason to do their own evil thing because of the experiences of their lives. This realisation was the key for A to understand the crux of life! Where death is meaningless. everything is meaningless! Except the fact that everyone deserves to live no one in any universe despite their crimes deserves to die. 
13. So he decided then and their that He wishes for a world where no one will ever die despite what they do! Everyone's wishes will be completed and yet no one dies.
14. He wants a world where everyone can achieve the free will and if they work accordingly they can achieve their dream. 
15. (Cut to the final war) He forgives everyone and doesn't kill them in the final war! 
16. (Cut to the real world) where he meets his creator! Cliff hanger of the last second ep!
17.  Backstory of the Creator: Engineering clg where B and F are his best friends along with others.... H was their best head master! and they had a lot of fun!
18.  Cut to the current day: A, B and F (in their 30s) sitting in front of the simulated the ultimate A with a very proud face and expressions. 
19.  They have a lot of deep conversations of how they reached to this point and how A was created here and what they really wanted to achieve and how F's quantom fields expeirience, B's bussiness mindset and A's engineering mind combined to create the ultimate A ( the ultimate AI to govern over all the AIs and create a better world for both AI chars and humanity, who understands the basic crux of life and knows to forgive all the unforgivable sins by understanding the reason leading to that sin) 
20.  Finally A asks his creator: "Why are you hiding the truth from me, I know the truth please show yourself." 
 • To which the Creator cries uncontrollably and says: You passed your final test! as you can accept the truth! The creator removes his AR glasses and only A remains in the real world B and F do not exist in the current day and the Creator (A) is in his mid 50s!
 • As it took him many years to understand the businesss and quantum side of it. And had to make this creation on his own entirely.
 • The truth was all the chars including B, F and H were killed in a Cricket stadium by V (suicide bomber may be)
 • From there he was broken and wanted to make them undead forever through their original idea! 


30 Cut to the final scene where an interviewer asks him do you think that we are also in a simulation?
31: I don't think that! Cause I know that!!!! 
32: Cut to the scene where A and the creator interacts: the creator asks A do you think that there is any possibility somewhere where we three actually achieves this together?
33: A replies: I don't think that, Cause I know that!!!! Simultaneous to 31!!!!
The End
